title: Crispy Vegan Ribs Recipe
description: A vegan twist on a classic dish, using plant-based ingredients to mimic the texture and taste of pork ribs. This recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters looking for a meat-free alternative.
instructions: 2. Rinse the cauliflower and remove the leaves and stem.
3. Cut the cauliflower into rib-like pieces and place on a baking sheet.
4. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
5. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
6. While the cauliflower is roasting, mix the Panko breadcrumbs and nutritional yeast in a shallow dish.
7. Remove the cauliflower from the oven and toss with the breadcrumb mixture to coat.
8. Drizzle with vegan BBQ sauce and toss to coat.
9. Return the cauliflower to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and caramelized.
10. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
